finalText:
Root cause: Redis dead.

**02:14:07** — `[api] redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache layer fall back to direct store reads.

**02:14:07 onward** — cache miss storm hit store direct, no caching buffer. Store overload, timeout errors (5000ms) every ~2sec across api/worker-1/worker-2/scheduler, nonstop.

**02:14–02:31** — request queue depth climb steady 52 to 568+ (max 500, breached ~02:25). Redis reconnect attempts fail every ~2min (attempts 0 through 12, all ECONNREFUSED same host 10.0.0.12:6379). Redis never come back whole incident.

**02:31:44** — `[worker-2] JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)`. Queue backlog ate memory, crash.

**02:31:45** — supervisor restart worker-2 (exit code 134).

**02:31:52** — `[supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down`. Full outage.

Chain: Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 die → no auto-reconnect success (12 tries, all fail, same target) → direct store reads overload store → queue backlog grow unbounded past max → worker-2 OOM crash → api unresponsive → supervisor kill whole process group.

Fix priorities: restore/redeploy Redis at 10.0.0.12, add backpressure/circuit breaker so queue don't grow past 500 silently (log warn but no shed), bound backlog memory on worker.
